We are looking for a Senior Manager to manage the engineering work within Digital Ventures at Jabra. This is an opportunity to build and develop a senior engineering team in a newly formed software organization, combining the pace of a growing initiative with the reach and support of a global company.

In the role of Senior Manager, Software Engineering — Digital Ventures in the Digital Experiences leadership team, you will contribute to our purpose of Bringing People Closer. You will set technical direction, build an effective engineering organization and turn early ideas into valuable customer outcomes.

**The Team You Will Be Part Of

**Digital Experiences builds the software around Jabra’s devices, including the applications, cloud services and experiences customers use every day. The organization brings together product, engineering and architecture capabilities to create scalable, high-quality digital experiences.

You will be part of the Digital Experiences leadership team and manage a small, senior engineering team. We aspire to create an environment with clear ownership, openness, fast feedback and thoughtful decisions informed by customer needs and real-world usage.

**Your Contribution Is Appreciated, And You Will

**

• Build, manage and develop a small senior engineering team, including recruitment, ways of working and engineering standards.

• Set the technical direction and architecture, making informed decisions on what to build, reuse or source externally.

• Deliver early versions to customers, learn from usage and feedback, and iterate in short, evidence-informed cycles.

• Partner with product and business stakeholders to assess opportunities and make decisions on where to focus, adapt or discontinue work.

• Embed security, privacy, identity and access management, and enterprise-grade quality from the outset.

• Establish scalable, secure and observable cloud services on Microsoft Azure, supported by modern engineering practices.

• Promote AI-assisted development, automation and fast feedback loops that support reliable delivery and continuous learning.

**To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

**

• Bring experience building a product and its engineering team from an early stage through to customer adoption, whether in an entrepreneurial environment, a new business area or an established organization.

• Have experience managing engineering teams and hiring senior engineers, creating clarity, accountability and an environment where people can develop.

• Bring direct technical knowledge of cloud-native architecture on Microsoft Azure, including services designed to scale securely and remain observable as adoption grows.

• Have experience developing enterprise software with appropriate security, privacy, compliance, and identity and access management practices.

• May have experience using customer data and adoption insights to inform product decisions, and building teams through a combination of in-house colleagues and external partners. Experience with business-to-business software or digital experiences around connected devices is beneficial.

At GN we pride ourselves on encouraging flexible work whenever possible. We trust our people to fulfill their responsibilities, to know when in-person collaboration is better than hybrid, and to be present when it's needed most.

**We encourage you to apply

**Even if you don’t match all the above-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting the invitation to the interview.

**How to apply?

**Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than December 12, 2026. Applications are assessed continuously, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV, including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy. We also welcome two or three lines on something you have built from scratch and what you would approach differently today.

**Join us in bringing people closer

**GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions.

spired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss to overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses, and provide great experiences for audio and gaming users.

**About

**GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here:

We are looking for an experienced Senior Ecommerce Manager to join Hårklinikken as we continue to develop and grow our global ecommerce business.

We operate six Shopify sites across the US, UK, EU, Denmark, Iceland and the UAE, with the US representing our largest growth market.

You will own how we present and sell Hårklinikken online, shaping a seamless and engaging experience that helps clients explore our offerings, find what is right for their individual needs and take the next step in their journey with us.

At the same time, you will own the sales plan and use data and customer behaviour to identify opportunities, improve conversion and continuously optimise the online experience. From merchandising and product launches to CRO, consultation booking, first purchase and the ecommerce roadmap, you will be responsible for making our sites commercially strong, seamless and easy to use.

Success in this role means delivering against the sales plan and continuously improving conversion rate, AOV and revenue across sites and markets.

Alongside commercial performance, you will ensure our sites are fast, stable and easy to use, working closely with our web agency and tech team to continuously improve the experience for our clients.

Primary Relationships

You will report to the Global Director of Ecommerce and work closely with the CRM & Lifecycle Manager as part of our ecommerce team in Copenhagen.

You will also collaborate closely with Brand, our clinics and Operations, particularly around merchandising, launches and the customer journey.

Externally, you will work closely with our web agency, technology team and relevant ecommerce partners.

Key Responsibilities

• Trading across six sites. Own the sales plan for each site, with campaigns and offers adapted to each market, and contribute to ecommerce forecasts throughout the year.

• Merchandising and launches. Determine what we feature and where to drive effective cross-sell and upsell. Coordinate online product launches with Brand, clinics and Operations, while keeping stock availability and our delivery promise on track.

• The CRO roadmap. Identify where we lose clients, develop and run tests, and roll out what works.

• The ecommerce backlog. Set priorities together with the Global Director of Ecommerce, brief our web agency and tech team, and manage incoming website requests, including knowing when to say no.

• The first step of the customer journey. Own and optimise the consultation booking flow, sign-ups, onsite offers and first purchase, in close collaboration with the CRM & Lifecycle Manager.

• E-tailers, SEO and GEO. Manage the day-to-day activities and relationships with relevant external partners.

Core Competencies

This role requires strong ecommerce experience combined with a hands-on, structured and analytical approach. You are comfortable owning your numbers, identifying problems through data and translating insights into clear priorities and actions.

You enjoy taking ownership and making decisions. You are comfortable saying no to the wrong request when necessary and can clearly explain the reasoning behind your priorities.

You don’t need to tick every box to be the right fit. We would love to hear from you if you bring strong ecommerce experience, a commercial mindset and a genuine drive to continuously improve the customer experience.

What You Bring:

• 5+ years of experience in ecommerce, with full ownership of a webshop’s trading and conversion.

• Deep Shopify experience, ideally Shopify Plus across multiple storefronts or markets.

• Experience with subscriptions in ecommerce, ideally Recharge.

• A strong CRO track record, with experience running tests and demonstrating their impact without compromising the brand.

• Strong GA4 and Shopify analytics capabilities, with the ability to identify problems and opportunities through data before looking for a solution.

• Experience leading agencies and developers through a roadmap and backlog.

• Fluent English.

• A structured approach, strong ownership of your numbers and the confidence to prioritise and say no when needed.

It is an advantage if you also have:

• Hands-on Amazon experience, ideally Seller Central in the US.

• Experience working with the US market.

• Experience working with a premium brand within beauty, wellness, fashion or lifestyle.

• Proficiency in a Scandinavian language.

Who Are We?

Founded in 1992 in Copenhagen, Hårklinikken is a leading scalp and hair health clinic with more than 30 years of experience. We help clients achieve optimal scalp health and long-lasting hair gain, combining expert guidance with clean and gentle products formulated to support healthy hair growth.

Our approach began with Hårklinikken’s founder and lead researcher, Lars Skjøth, who developed a diagnostic, consultation-based approach centred around understanding each client’s individual scalp and hair needs. Today, The Hårklinikken Method brings together decades of expertise with the personalised care that has been at the heart of Hårklinikken from the beginning.

Clients come to us in different ways, whether through a consultation or by discovering and purchasing our products online. Through virtual consultations or in person at our clinics in New York, Beverly Hills, Copenhagen, Aarhus, Dubai and Reykjavik, our Hair Specialists combine their expertise with an individual assessment of each client’s scalp, hair, lifestyle and environment to create a personalised regimen designed around their specific needs.

However their journey begins, we are here to guide and support our clients along the way. From helping them find what is right for their individual needs to supporting them in achieving the best possible results, we want every client to feel confident, understood and cared for throughout their Hårklinikken journey.

We’re on a mission to help as many people as possible achieve fuller, stronger, healthier hair with products that are powered by science, perfected by experts and proven by over 100,000 clients.

What We Offer

• A new team, where you shape how we work from day one

• Full ownership of six sites in six markets

• Short decision paths in an owner-led company

• Close work with our clinics, where the treatment starts

• A real work-life balance, with flexibility in how you plan your day

• An international team and modern clinics with a strong focus on quality and aesthetics

• Growth opportunities in a safe work environment

• Pension, holiday allowance and discounts on our products and treatments

The role reports to the Global Director of Ecommerce and is based on site in Copenhagen. It is a permanent, full-time position, starting as soon as possible.

Questions? Contact Emma Cronwall Trampedach at +45 3133 5432.

Equal Employment Opportunities

We offer equal employment opportunity to qualified individuals without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We strongly believe that cultivating a diverse workplace gives a company strength. The combination of unique skills, abilities, experiences, and backgrounds creates an environment that produces extraordinary results.

Experienced Oracle database developer at Novo Nordisk Engineering

If you’re motivated by developing and maintaining database solutions in close collaboration with customers, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for an Oracle database developer to join our Software Engineering team of 15 people. As a team, we are working on developing innovative software solutions for the pharmaceutical industry.

Our work includes both a MCS (Material Control System) and a MES (Manufacturing Execution System). In this role, you will play a key part in the continued development and support of our MCS solution, working closely with our customer. Over time, you will also have the opportunity to become involved in the development and support of our MES platform.

How you might spend your days

As an Oracle database developer you’ll be:

• Developing new features for MCS. You will become involved in all phases - planning, requirements, design, development, code review, tests, deployment and documentation.

• Supporting MCS in case of incidents. Support is within normal office hours.

• Working closely with 3 other members of the MCS team and with the customer. You will be at our customer’s site in Hillerød 2-3 days per week and in our Virum office the rest of the time.

• Delivering software according to internal and customer procedures. We will train you in our Quality Management System, GxP and compliance.

• Using AI tools for software development.

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Motivated by working with colleagues and customers towards shared goals

• Responsible for progressing your assignments and following through to completion

• A quick learner and a good problem-solver

• Organised in your work and committed to following established processes

• Communicating openly and proactively with colleagues and customers

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• Master's or bachelor's degree in software engineering or similar degree

• 5+ years of experience in software development

• 5+ years of experience with Oracle Database, Oracle SQL and PL/SQL, Oracle Forms/Reports

• Experience with AI-assisted software development

• You speak and write English fluently

• Experience in some of the following is an advantage: Agile software development, XML, Linux, SAP, interface technologies

• Experience in the pharmaceutical industry, including GxP, is an advantage but not a requirement

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 30th November 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Peter Møller at +45 3075 5186.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

JYSK is looking for an HR Manager who can translate business needs into relevant HR initiatives and create results through others. You will take on a broad and impactful role at JYSK's Head Office in Brabrand, where you will act as HR partner for selected business areas while also leading and developing the Talent Acquisition team.

Reporting to HR Director of JYSK Head Office, you will work closely with leaders as a trusted HR partner, supporting them in areas such as performance, development and retention. You build strong and trusted relationships, challenge constructively and help leaders make decisions that support both employees and the business.

At the same time, you will set the direction for the Talent Acquisition team. You establish clear priorities, develop and coach team members and empower them to take ownership of their individual areas of responsibility. • 
Acting as a trusted HR partner for leaders across selected business areas

• 
Driving development, training and coaching of leaders and specialists

• 
Supporting performance management and identifying, developing and retaining internal talent

• 
Advising leaders on employee relations and disciplinary matters

• 
Leading, coaching and developing the Talent Acquisition team with clear expectations, priorities and continuous follow-up

•

You will join JYSK in a broad and influential HR role where results, development and strong commercial values are at the heart of the business. Would you like to be part of JYSK?

JYSK is an international home furnishing retailer with Scandinavian roots and part of the family-owned Lars Larsen Group. The company offers products for sleeping and living through more than 3,700 stores and webshops in 49 countries and employs approximately 38,000 people.

jobs.description:
**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the teams by creating or helping create great guest experiences, and use every day as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer or staff member; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of people who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You'll learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path—our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

****Full-time

****Maternity leave cover: January - June 2027

**As Senior Product Development Manager, you'll be the senior product voice in the Menu & Innovation team, owning our highest priority global NPD projects and the systems, standards and ways of working that sit behind every product we launch. Based at our Global HQ in Copenhagen, you'll work closely with Brand, Marketing, Operations, Technical, Franchise partners, Supply Chain and our supplier partners to make sure JOE products are consistently great in every market. This is a lead role in the menu & product team: you'll set the direction for how we develop, test and approve products worldwide, coach the wider team, and help shape how the team grows and operates globally. You'll have real scope to define the future of our global menu, always keeping juicer ease at the heart.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Drive end-to-end ownership of high priority global NPD projects, including new categories, new occasions and growth platforms, from brief through to in-store launch.

• Lead on all global NPD systems and processes, defining and continuously optimising them as JOE scales.

• Define and own the JOE global product testing framework and approach for all products, from scale-up kitchen trials to product operational testing to global scale commercial consumer testing.

• Lead on future NPD team growth strategies and the expansion of our global operating model.

• Own all core EPD quality workstreams across defined products and categories.

• Own all product and ingredient standards, making sure the JOE quality bar is upheld globally.

• Lead high functioning cross-functional project teams; with all global teams and local markets, from Operations and Marketing to Franchise and Supply Chain.

• Champion best-in-class trend diagnosis, coaching the wider team on how to diagnosis, read & interpret trends, in a Joe way, and run sharp competitor reviews to keep a finger on the pulse.

• Partner with all key suppliers, owning strong relationship management and engagement across current and new suppliers for current and future projects.

• Maintain and nurture a tightly connected global product network across equity and franchise; now and as it scales, so opportunities are identified, shared and recognised and everyone stays aligned.

• Key point of contact for our franchise team (current and new) on all product activity beyond equity stores; ensuring global brand consistency whilst driving local relevancy

**WHO YOU ARE

**

• A defining ability to translate concepts into scalable, operationally sound recipes without losing sight of brand and quality standards.

• Excellent project management skills and experience

• Senior stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions, markets and franchise partners.

• Experience coaching and developing others

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• Min. 8 years' experience in corporate product development, ideally within QSR (Quick Service Restaurant), with a track record of owning global or multi-market launches.

• Proven experience building or improving NPD systems, processes and testing frameworks, including scale-up, operational and consumer testing.

• Deep familiarity with stage-gate or gate approval governance.

• Strong supplier management skills, with experience owning relationships across a global supply base.

• Fluent in English - other languages are a bonus!

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 130 friendly faces come together!

• Enjoy our fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Join us for our lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars-there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

• Stay fit and healthy with our well-equipped fitness facilities, complete with showers and a relaxing steam room to refresh after your workouts.

Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

**

**What We’re About

**But we’re more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.

**When You Join DESMI, You Can Expect

**

• A collaborative and supportive team environment.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.

• A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.

• A company that values sustainability and innovation.

We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive – if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.

As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies – the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

**Ready to apply?

**If you're a motivated individual seeking a challenging and rewarding career where you can contribute to a more sustainable future, we encourage you to apply!

Use the Apply button to submit your application. We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

If you have questions about the role, you are welcome to contact Jacob Rathgen - DESMI at jara@desmi.com.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

DCS Automation Specialist – ABB 800xA for Novo Nordisk Engineering

Do you want to be a part of NNE’s all-time largest Process Automation team? We are looking for a colleague to join our fantastic company, where we have the aspiration of becoming best in class within Automation Solutions for Pharmaceutical Engineering.

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

Imagine seeing your automation solutions come to life in pharma facilities that are essential for millions of patients. In our DCS Automation team, deep DCS expertise meets real process understanding – and you'll be at the centre of it.

Why you'll enjoy working here:

• Greenfield projects at scale: An exciting pipeline of large, data-driven greenfield plants with modular, scalable designs.

• The full automation lifecycle: Consultancy, design and development, implementation and validation of automation solutions for the pharma and biotech industries.

• Real process depth: Work across API production areas such as fermentation, recovery and purification, utility and cleaning systems.

• Room to innovate: Our solutions are built on a deep understanding of our customers' production processes – and when standard components can't do the job, we develop our own.

• A strong professional community: 80+ DCS Automation colleagues in Denmark and 200+ globally, from graduate engineers to senior specialists and leads.

How you might spend your days

As a DCS Application Specialist, you'll join a diverse, collaborative team where no two days look the same. You will:

• Shape the control systems. Design, develop, implement, qualify and support Process Control Systems, using your deep PCS/DCS expertise and your hands-on feel for how client plants really run.

• Stand side by side with the client. Work closely with the client's Operational Responsible and operators, from the first design discussions through to commissioning.

• Solve problems where code meets equipment. Track down and resolve whatever shows up when the software meets the physical plant.

• Fine-tune to the finish line. Optimise the processes until they are ready for final handover.

• Connect with experts across disciplines. Exchange ideas with process experts and colleagues who specialise in MES, historian systems, instruments, production equipment and more.

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Respectful of your colleagues’ individual and cultural differences

• Aware of your surroundings and able to flag any concerns

• Agile and able to prioritize urgent tasks

• Team-oriented and able to collaborate on team projects

• Reliable, curious and eager to learn

• Appreciative of feedback, because it contributes to your growth

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• Engineering foundation: A degree in electrical, automation, process or marine engineering – or equivalent experience

• Hands-on DCS skills: Proven experience designing and coding PCS/DCS applications, ideally in ABB 800xA or ABB SattLine

• Batch know-how: Understanding of batch production and ISA-88 – or a strong drive to build it quickly

• Regulated or project experience: Experience from GMP/GAMP environments or from executing automation projects – and you find the complexity of GMP/GAMP meaningful

• Cross-disciplinary mindset: You collaborate easily with process experts and colleagues working on MES, Historian, instrumentation and production equipment

• Digital and AI-savvy: You use AI tools, scripting (e.g. Python) and smart engineering tools to work faster, standardise and reuse solutions

• Future-oriented: You are motivated by modular, data-driven and scalable automation design

Why choose NNE?

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 14th December 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Please contact Manager Ditte Høiberg Møller on +45 3075 5028 or Manager Volker J. Jentzsch on +45 3191 1540.

Please note:

Fair hiring:

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the teams by creating or helping create great guest experiences, and use every day as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer or staff member; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of people who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You'll learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path—our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**The Global Leadership Training Lead is responsible for owning the company's leadership and talent training standard, ensuring that people at every career step are equipped with the skills and mind-set for their role. The role owns the leadership curriculum, including the JOE’s leadership development program(s), coaching and feedback modules and team development tools, facilitates Train-the trainer programs, and partners with Operations, Culture and regional T&LD to embed leadership training across operational and office-based career paths. As part of the Talent & Leadership Development team within People & Development, this position shapes how the company builds leaders at scale, supporting the company's purpose and growth ambitions.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Own the leadership training curriculum and set the standard for how leadership is trained at every career step, for operational and office-based roles.

• Develop and own the company's leadership development program(s), scaling them from pilot to company-wide availability at speed.

• Shape the leadership training content standard within the operational training journey together with Operations, ensuring leadership training is consistent from store to office.

• Develop and own coaching and feedback modules and a team development toolbox that become the common leadership toolkit across the organization.

• Ensure training is anchored in the talent development process, leadership standards and the competency framework, applying an approach of growth assignments, coaching by leaders and formal training.

• Facilitate selected leadership programs, especially pilots and new launches, and own and facilitate the train-the-trainer certification for People Business Partners and regional T&LD, ensuring consistent delivery quality across regions.

• Develop content and facilitator materials, aligned with Operations training and Culture on the shared learning platform.

• Define how training impact is measured, linking participation and feedback to talent and performance outcomes, and use insight to guide decisions on the learning portfolio.

**WHO YOU ARE

**

• Passionate about leadership. A standard-setter who works with high autonomy, setting the bar for how we build leaders

• A builder who creates a pilot and take it to company-wide availability at speed

• A facilitator who energises a room, from a bar back room to the office meeting room

• Operationally credible: you know what a busy shift and running a store demands of a leader and design training that fits it

• A partner who cooperates and influences across Operations, Culture, People Business Partners and regional T&LD without needing authority

• Curious and data-led: you want proof that training changes behaviour and results

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• 7+ years in leadership development, L&D or talent roles, ideally in global multi-site quick service restaurant, retail or similar front line heavy industry

• Proven track record designing and delivering content and facilitator materials, incl. blended or digital learning for leadership programmes, including coaching and feedback modules

• Hands-on facilitation experience, ideally with train-the-trainer or certification programmes

• Experience measuring training impact and linking it to performance outcomes

• Leadership experience and/or relevant education

• Fluent in English - other languages are a bonus

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

**Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

****ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!
